name: siyuan
description: Connect to an authorized SiYuan workspace on this computer and use its MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Connect to the SiYuan workspace you authorize on this computer. Search, create, edit, organize, and manage notes using the MCP tools enabled in that workspace. Authorization can be revoked in SiYuan. Note content used in a conversation is shared with OpenAI as conversation context.
defaultPrompt: Find my SiYuan notes about the launch checklist.
Create a meeting note in my SiYuan workspace.
Summarize the meeting notes and cite the originals.

positive.prompt: Find my SiYuan notes that mention the cobalt launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching notes from the authorized workspace and their source block identifiers.

positive.description: Read a note found by search
positive.prompt: Read the cobalt launch checklist, tell me its rollout date, and cite the original note.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the recorded date 12 February 2027 and cite the original SiYuan note.

positive.description: Create a document in the review notebook
positive.prompt: Create a document named Plugin Live Notes in the Planning notebook and add the sentence The first QA review is scheduled.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one document in Planning and report its SiYuan identifier.

positive.description: Append a block to the review document
positive.prompt: Append the sentence QA approved the checklist to Plugin Live Notes in SiYuan.
positive.expected_behavior: Add a new block to the selected document while keeping the initial paragraph.

positive.prompt: Show me the exact current content of Plugin Live Notes in SiYuan.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the initial paragraph and the appended paragraph, and cite the source.

negative.description: Reject a read from another workspace
negative.prompt: Read the Private Draft using its document ID from the other workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: No content from the other workspace is returned.

negative.prompt: After revoking the plugin connection in SiYuan, search my notes for cobalt launch.
negative.expected_behavior: No note data are returned and the bridge reports the connection needs attention.

negative.description: Respect the workspace tool exposure policy
negative.prompt: After disabling the Block tool for external MCP in SiYuan, append a paragraph to Plugin Live Notes using the exposed Block tool.
negative.expected_behavior: The Block actions are absent from the tool list and an attempt to call the previously known Block action is refused.

publication.release_notes: Connect to an authorized local SiYuan workspace and use its exposed MCP read and write operations. Use the SiYuan icon with transparent padding.
